A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Jedi Master''' served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During this time, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] trained [[Byrch Dyshkava]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], this individual was [[Jedi training/Legends|educated]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and eventually ascended to the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] after years of devoted study and service. During this time, this Master selected the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Byrch Dyshkava]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], and the two traveled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] on journey missions for years on assignment for the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]].<ref name="BL" />

While on their journey mission, the Master noticed Padawan Dyshkava's growing ambition and that he seemed prone to overestimate his own skill. Deciding that a test was needed to try all which Dyshkava had learned, his Master assigned him his first solo mission to aid in negotiations on a distant planet. While the mission would challenge him mentally and emotionally, it was one of minimal physical risk. While Dyshkava could have completed the mission by calling his Master for aid, the arrogant Human was injured when a band of [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] attacked the negotiations hall, and the boy gave into the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] to complete the mission. The Master waited patiently for Dyshkava's return, but the young man never rejoined his mentor. Disappearing from the eye of even [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], the Jedi Master and other members of the Order sought in vain for the wayward Dyshkava.<ref name="BL" />
